# Billing Requirements Checklist: Google Play Billing (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 018 — the P-12.3 billing-surface limit, "never acknowledge, never grant locally", idempotent retries across process death, restore and refusal coverage, privacy of purchase data, gating of US6 and the Play Billing dependency, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): billing-policy and money safety first (P-12, acknowledge, grants), then recovery and idempotency, then refusal/restore coverage, then UX, accessibility and contract fidelity; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, research or contracts in the same session; each says where. `[x]` = reviewed and holds (or fixed); unchecked items are left for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the full set of billing actions on the Plan screen enumerated, including the Google Play links and when each shows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-030, FR-031]
- [x] CHK002 Is it stated that the app never acknowledges or consumes a purchase, and never grants locally? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are all triggers that look for purchases listed, with their rate floors? [Gap → fixed: FR-010 "Plan screen … (no floor)"; foreground floor 60 s]
- [x] CHK004 Is it defined whether restore and the background verify pass can run at the same time? [Gap → fixed: FR-011 "verify and restore passes included"]
- [x] CHK005 Is the relation between the sign-in restore and the sign-in verify pass defined, and is a cold start distinguished from a sign-in? [Gap → fixed: FR-020, research R-4]
- [x] CHK006 Does a tapped restore send purchases refused earlier in the run? [Gap → fixed: FR-021 "including any refused earlier in this run"]
- [x] CHK007 Is the lifetime of the restore result message defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-023 "stays until … dismisses … leaves the Plan screen"]
- [x] CHK008 Is the price's loading state defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-036 "no price (no placeholder)"]
- [x] CHK009 Are the requirements for the iOS build stated (what shows, what does not)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055, research R-15]
- [x] CHK010 Is the development and E2E path without Google defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-056, research R-12, contracts/ui-and-e2e.md]
- [x] CHK011 Are what the owner must approve and supply listed in one place? [Completeness, Spec §9, plan "What the owner must approve or supply"]
- [x] CHK012 Is a catalogue reload defined after an unknown-product refusal? [Gap → fixed: FR-016 "the catalogue is reloaded once"]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK013 Is "stable Idempotency-Key" defined precisely enough to test across process death (inputs, format, when it changes)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, research R-3]
- [x] CHK014 Is "pending" defined from the answer body rather than the HTTP status? [Clarity, data-model §2, contracts/google-play-api-client.md]
- [x] CHK015 Is the retry policy quantified (delays, cap, max sends)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK016 Is "Google Play's price" defined (which offer, which phase, which currency, rounding)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036, research R-10]
- [x] CHK017 Is it unambiguous which purchase the "Test purchase" label refers to? [Ambiguity → fixed: FR-034 "governing provider `google_play` and its plan is the catalogue plan of that purchase's product"]
- [x] CHK018 Is "Fix payment" defined for hold even though a held subscription no longer governs? [Conflict → fixed: FR-001 now defers to FR-031]
- [x] CHK019 Is the subscription-centre link's exact form defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-054, research R-8]
